sources.landblocks: the cells below: the high word of each outdoor cell id (six landblocks: 0xA3B1, 0xA4B0, 0xA4B1, 0xA5AF, 0xA5B0, 0xA6AF), from today's HuntGround.LowB (M4 1.1 s4a)
sources.arrival: the first place of a hunt: outdoor.cells[0], at its stop point (HuntScenario.NextCell); an outdoor ground has no portal, so the heading is not used
sources.walk: not used by an outdoor ground: the hunt's cell travels are the travel seam's point goals (HuntScenario.NextCell, TravelPurpose.Cell), not a room-graph walk; these are the dungeon walk's defaults (no doorways, stop within 1.0 m, no dwell, a leg at most WayfindScenario.LegMarginSeconds = 300 s)
sources.storeys: none: an outdoor ground has no storeys
sources.no_go: none: the hunt keeps out of no cell by a list; it keeps to dry, walkable terrain (outdoor.cells[].terrain and HuntGround.SeekHeight)
sources.targets: none: an outdoor ground's creatures are outdoor.creatures and the hunt takes those in level_band; which classes a character will not fight is the character's (FighterTemplate.AvoidedTargets), not the ground's
sources.level_band: today's HuntGround.LowB band 8-20: ACE rolls a generator's children by cumulative probability, so the band is 8 to 20 (M4 1.1's SELECT, the correction of spec 5.9)
sources.portal: none: the hunt goes from Holtburg by a place or on foot, with no portal
sources.home: a measure (session.md section 41, M4 4.2 FS): Holtburg's lifestone in cell 0xA9B40019 and the known point (84, 7.7) off it, z 94 (TravelStations.HoltburgLifestone); the ground is hunted from Holtburg and returns there
sources.vendors: none: the hunt's selling and its kit buying are the journey's shop stations at Holtburg (HuntOptions, ShopStations), not this profile
sources.spell_plan: none: the hunters fight with a melee weapon or a bow (FighterTemplate); an outdoor ground has no spell plan
sources.components: none: no spell plan, no components
sources.supplies: none: an outdoor ground buys nothing from its profile (D48, m5-plan.md section 4.5 row m0): the hunters shop at the journey stations at Holtburg (HuntOptions, ShopStations) and carry no spell components, so the section is empty: no stock lines, no kit and a purse of 0; burden_trip_percent 90 is the section default and is not used by an outdoor ground
sources.hold_spots: none: today's hunt stands at its cells and holds no spot
sources.respawn: none listed: the creatures are ACE encounters, not placed generator instances with fixed guids (the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, encounter table: generator wcid 1999 "Low B Aluvian Generator" at nine of the ten cells, 2001 at 0xA4B10012, each child's delay 1200 s); ACE creates the generator at the spot when the landblock loads
sources.tour: none: the hunt visits outdoor.cells in their order
sources.outdoor: cells: today's HuntGround.LowB (M4 1.1 s4a: the cell ids and map coordinates from the pinned world SQL, nearest Holtburg first; terrain the dat test's finding of 2026-10-20, re-read by HuntingGroundDatTests) with the stop point at the cell's centre, (cell x * 24 + 12, cell y * 24 + 12), as the hunt has always placed, z 0 because the terrain height is read from the dats at the point and never copied; creatures: today's HuntGround.LowBTable (the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, generators 1999 and 2001 three levels down, 37 rows, levels 4 to 30), spawn_mass computed from the same SQL: the mean over the ten cells of the chance that one roll of the cell's encounter generator (cumulative probability rows, nested generators multiplied, a creature that is itself a generator counted with its young) spawns the creature; acquire_radius_m 60 is HuntScenario.MeleeRange (a missile hunt's 35 m is the weapon's, HuntScenario.MissileRange); cell_cap 8 is HuntScenario.OnFootMaxCells (the on-foot search's bound, M4 P5b fix FC-a3); expected_yield_per_spot is the sum of spawn_mass over the creatures in level_band
